In an Arab household people expect moms to carry every burden quietly. They picture her day as non-stop work and duty. Always serious. Always holding everything together. So when she puts on music and just lets herself dance some people act surprised. Like taking that light moment takes something away from her role. Growing up Moroccan I learned that warmth comes from both. The care she gives and the joy she keeps alive. Seeing her happy changes nothing about our roots. It only makes home feel lighter. #moroccan #🇲🇦 #arab #culture #family #dontjudge

5 things to know before going to Marrakech👇🇲🇦 1️⃣ Moroccan taxis WILL overcharge you, download @inDrive before you arrive. It works at the airport, you set your own price, so there’s no negotiation needed 🚖  2️⃣ Be aware of the animal abuse at Jemaa el-Fnaa. Men walk the square with monkeys in chains and snakes with their teeth removed, don’t pay if they confront you 🙊  3️⃣ Where you stay matters. I found my riad on the @cozycozy app, which compared the prices across all the major booking sites. Agoda was £40 vs £45 on Booking.com, saving £35 over 7 nights 🏨  4️⃣ Eat all the street food. Vendors need licences, so it’s clean, fresh and cheap. I reccoemnd trying this sardine salad just off the main square, search “fried fish” on google maps 🍗  5️⃣ Stay safe in the medina. Wear your backpack on your front, watch out for pickpockets, ignore the men on street corners and download offline maps before you arrive 🎒  Save this video for your trip to Morocco 📌 #marrakech #morocco #jemaaelfna #cozycozy #ad

𝑵𝑨𝑫𝑶𝑹 𝑻𝑹𝑨𝑽𝑬𝑳 𝑮𝑼𝑰𝑫𝑬 🇲🇦🙋🏼‍♀️🌅🌿☀️ Planning a trip to Nador? Save these 5 experiences for your next visit! From outdoor adventures to local food and culture, there’s so much to discover. 🤍 🐎 1. Horse riding & galloping on the beach — @equitation_nador Whether you’re a complete beginner or an experienced rider, there’s something for you! From riding lessons at the stable to mountain trail rides and camping trips in the forest for the ultimate adventure 🏕️🐴 What makes this stable extra special is the genuine love and care they give their horses, from daily showers to providing proper diets and making their wellbeing a priority. A truly horse-friendly stable with amazing people and skilled riders who teach with so much passion. 🩷 🏜️ 2. Quad biking & cave exploring — Explore the landscapes around Nador on an unforgettable 2.5-hour quad biking and cave adventure. This was also taken care of by @equitation_nador, huge thanks to them for offering so many cool activities! 🐒 3. Feed the monkeys 📍Mount Gourougou — Buy a bag of peanuts and enjoy these curious little guys up close! Just watch your belongings… they might steal more than your peanuts. 😂 Be careful, respect the animals and enjoy the moment. Such a unique experience! (Peanuts are also available at the location!) 🫖 4. Experience a local souq in Selouane Wander through the market, shop, eat freshly prepared meat and enjoy traditional Moroccan tea. Great place for a traditional Moroccan breakfast😋 The market takes place every Saturday! A glimpse into everyday local life that feels worlds away from the Netherlands. 🇲🇦 (Other markets take place on different days, too, so ask around and explore!) 🐟 5. Eat fresh seafood at Dorade — @restau.dorade.fsh Fresh fish straight from the sea and oysters you won’t want to miss! 😋 Come hungry, because this is a must for seafood lovers. 📌 Save this guide for your next trip to Nador! #nador #morocco #visitmorocco #travelguide #marokko
